text: ChatCanvas 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的对话创作插件，提供富文本、可编辑画布、交互界面、数学图像和音乐功能。它注册作品创建、读取及 UI 模拟工具，并保存插件偏好。用户可在聊天中创作画布或文档、检查交互并持续修改，适合把想法发展成可探索草稿并继续讨论的 Harness 的 Harness 使用者。

ChatCanvas adds rich messages, editable canvases, interactive UI, math plots and music to DSH web chats. It registers tools to create and read artifacts and simulate UI events. Users can make drafts, inspect interactions and refine work in conversation.
想在 DSH 对话里直接画一张可编辑的草图。
能不能让我做一个可以在聊天中试用的小界面？
我想把函数画出来并调整参数观察变化。
有没有办法在对话里创作并试听一段音乐？
让 DSH 把想法整理成可交互的画布作品。
我希望在聊天消息里使用更丰富的格式和内容。
I want to sketch and revise a canvas while chatting with DSH.
Can I prototype an interactive interface inside a conversation?
ChatCanvas 的功能「组合画布发布」：可将组合画布作为作品发布到当前会话，并返回可读取的作品引用；工具会校验画布结构后保存快照。
ChatCanvas 的功能「读取作品」：可读取当前会话中发布的画布快照或已提交文档，并返回结构摘要，便于继续讨论作品内容。
ChatCanvas 的功能「模拟交互界面」：可对 UI 文档模拟最多 30 个事件，返回页面与本地状态，帮助在发布前检查交互逻辑。
ChatCanvas 的功能「本地偏好设置」：插件通过宿主设置接口读取和保存偏好，并将设置写入 DSH_HOME 下的本地存储目录。

dsh-chatcanvas README · What you can do：| Feature | In the conversation |
| --- | --- |
| Rich input and messages | Writing boxes, plain-text boxes, code highlighting, copying and native file references |
| Canvas | Draw, erase, arrange objects, snap to guides, control layers and share editable copies |
| Interactive UI | Build pages and controls, edit visual programs and try the result locally |
| Math | Explore functions, equations, parameters and 2D/3D plots |
| Music | Edit notes and tracks, audition instruments, import MIDI, export MIDI/WAV and transcribe WAV/MP3 locally |
| Visual questions | Let the AI show an editable draft and ask you to adjust it before proceeding |

dsh-chatcanvas README · Install：This is a **preview release**. Tested integration targets: DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2**. The installation helper is for Windows. Other host versions and operating systems have not been verified.

dsh-chatcanvas README · Install：1. Fully quit Harness. If the old local ChatCanvas or combined renderer is installed, disable/remove it first; see [migration](docs/PUBLICATION.md#english).
2. Find the desktop app's bundled `resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd`.
3. Run `dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add dsh-chatcanvas@1.4.0-rc.13` using that CLI's full path.
4. Reopen Harness. The plugin settings section is **对话画布 · ChatCanvas**.
dsh-chatcanvas README · Install：The GitHub-generated **Source code** archive is for developers. It is not the compiled installation package. See [installation and rollback](docs/INSTALL.md).

dsh-chatcanvas README · Install：**npm / Discover:** `dsh-chatcanvas@1.4.0-rc.13` is available on npm and in this repository's [third-party market source](docs/PUBLICATION.md#add-the-market-source). The downloaded npm archive has been checked against the reviewed prebuilt package. The older `1.4.0-rc.12` package remains in [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Tryanstm/dsh-chatcanvas/releases).

dsh-chatcanvas README · Start using it：Write normally, or right-click the composer to insert content. Ask the AI to create a UI preview, math plot, music project or shared canvas. Use an editable copy when you want to modify an already-sent work.

Example prompts:

- “Create a two-page timer interface that I can try here.”
- “Plot y = a*x² and let me change a.”
- “Make a short piano melody and show the notes for editing.”
- “Show an editable layout draft and ask me to adjust it.”

dsh-chatcanvas README · Start using it：The interface currently uses **Simplified Chinese**. This repository provides English and Chinese documentation. Full English UI localization is not included in this preview.

dsh-chatcanvas README · Settings：Open **Settings → 对话画布 · ChatCanvas**. The public plugin exposes only two preferences:

| Preference | Default | How to change it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Program recommendations / 程序推荐选项 | 2 | Click the count, choose 0–5, then save |
| AI recommendations / AI 推荐选项 | 1 | Click the count, choose 0–5, then save |

dsh-chatcanvas README · Settings：Execution auditing, audit switches and tool/Skill whitelists are not part of this plugin. The host's permission controls remain available. Existing document and storage identifiers are retained for compatibility with older works.

dsh-chatcanvas README · Permissions, privacy and cost：ChatCanvas does not register an execution-review gate or change the host's permission presets. Host permissions continue to apply. Canvas/UI editing and audio transcription use local code and packaged assets. AI text recommendations, translations, their quality checks and automatic conversation titles use the model configured in Harness and may incur extra usage. See [privacy and model usage](docs/PRIVACY.md).

dsh-chatcanvas README · Preview limitations：- Audio transcription is an editable estimate; dense mixes and overlapping instruments can produce incorrect notes.
- Sampled playback is not a professional instrument library. Some instruments sound more convincing than others.
- UI simulation checks program logic; it does not replace visual testing.
- Long drawing sessions, high-DPI rendering and interactions with other plugins need further real-window testing.
- Normal Markdown tables remain supported. The old standalone enhanced-table editor is retired.
dsh-chatcanvas README · Development：See [build and test instructions](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md), [integration](docs/INTEGRATION.md) and [document protocol](docs/PROTOCOL.md).

dsh-chatcanvas README · Feedback：Use the issue templates for bug reports and feature requests. Include the plugin version, Harness version, operating system and steps to reproduce. Share sanitized examples and screenshots. Avoid API keys and private conversations.

dsh-chatcanvas README · License and credits：Plugin code: [MIT](LICENSE). Bundled assets retain their own licenses: TimGM6mb SoundFont is **GPL-2.0-only**; Basic Pitch and TensorFlow.js assets are **Apache-2.0**. See [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and bundled license/source material. The MIT label for plugin code does not relicense third-party assets.

This project is not an official DeepSeek product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. Upstream DeepSeek Harness components retain their original notices.

dsh-chatcanvas README · 功能：| 功能 | 可以做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 富文本输入与消息 | 写作框、纯文本框、代码高亮、复制和原生文件引用 |
| 画布 | 手绘、实时擦除、吸附对齐、层级调整、复制并编辑作品 |
| 交互 UI | 制作多个页面、编辑图形程序，并直接试用界面 |
| 数学图像 | 探索函数、方程、参数和二维／三维图像 |
| 音乐 | 编辑音符与音轨、试听乐器、导入 MIDI、导出 MIDI/WAV，以及本地 WAV/MP3 转录 |
| 可编辑提问 | AI 展示草案，你直接调整，再把结果提交给 AI |

dsh-chatcanvas README · 安装：当前是**公开测试版**。已验证的集成目标为 Harness **0.2.0-rc.2 和 0.2.1-rc.2**。安装辅助脚本适用于 Windows；其他系统及宿主版本尚未验证。

1. 完全退出 Harness；已安装旧本地包或组合渲染器时先禁用／移除旧包，见[迁移说明](docs/PUBLICATION.md#简体中文)。
2. 找到桌面应用自带的 `resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd`。
3. 用该 CLI 的完整路径执行 `dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add dsh-chatcanvas@1.4.0-rc.13`。
4. 重新打开，在设置中找到 **对话画布 · ChatCanvas**。

GitHub 自动生成的 **Source code** 是开发源码，不能直接作为插件包安装。详细步骤、更新与回退见[安装说明](docs/INSTALL.zh-CN.md)。

dsh-chatcanvas README · 安装：**npm／发现页：** [dsh-chatcanvas@1.4.0-rc.13](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-chatcanvas/v/1.4.0-rc.13) 已上架 npm，可通过本仓库的第三方市场源发现安装。线上下载包已与核验过的本地预编译包逐字节校验。[查看市场源与旧本地包迁移说明](docs/PUBLICATION.md#简体中文)。旧版 `1.4.0-rc.12` 安装包仍保留在 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Tryanstm/dsh-chatcanvas/releases)。

dsh-chatcanvas README · 怎么开始：正常输入消息，或在输入框中右键插入内容。可以让 AI 制作 UI、数学图像、音乐作品或组合画布。已经发送的作品需要复制为可编辑副本后再修改。

可以这样说：

- “制作一个两页计时器界面，让我直接试用。”
- “画出 y = a*x²，让我调节 a。”
- “制作一段短钢琴旋律，把音符显示出来让我修改。”
- “先给我一份可以直接调整的布局草案，再询问我的意见。”

本版界面语言为**简体中文**；提供中英文文档，尚未包含完整英文界面。

dsh-chatcanvas README · 设置：打开 **设置 → 对话画布 · ChatCanvas**。公开插件只提供两项设置：

| 选项 | 默认数量 | 调整方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 程序推荐选项 | 2 项 | 点击数字，在弹窗中选择 0–5 项，再保存 |
| AI 推荐选项 | 1 项 | 点击数字，在弹窗中选择 0–5 项，再保存 |

执行审核、审核开关和工具／Skill 白名单不在本插件中。宿主自带的权限菜单继续保留。为兼容旧作品，内部文档格式和存储标识保持不变。
dsh-chatcanvas README · 权限、隐私与费用：插件不注册执行前审核，也不更改宿主权限预设。宿主权限继续生效。画布、UI 编辑和音频转录使用本地代码及随包资源；AI 推荐、翻译、推荐质量检查和自动生成会话标题会使用 Harness 配置的模型，可能产生额外用量。详见[隐私说明](docs/PRIVACY.zh-CN.md)。

dsh-chatcanvas README · 测试版限制：- 音频转录给出可修改的识别结果；复杂混音、多人声及重叠乐器可能识别不准。
- 采样播放不等同于专业乐器音源，部分乐器的真实感仍有限。
- UI 模拟验证逻辑，不能代替视觉验收。
- 长时间绘制、高 DPI 及与其他插件组合的正式窗口体验仍需更多测试。
- 普通 Markdown 表格继续支持，旧版独立增强表格编辑器已经退役。
